response.summary: Preserved morning matches and moved afternoon fixtures to resume at 15:30 after the rain closure. Because the 13:00–15:30 blackout reduces post-rain capacity to 18 match slots before the 19:00 session cutoff, four Round 5 matches could not be accommodated. Consider extending evening session hours or scheduling another day to complete the remaining Round 5 fixtures.
